title: installer-request
description: Makes an installer (or a bootstrap token). Without `site` it is for one cabinet. With `site` it is a site installer: for up to `cabinets` cabinets of that site, and of `role` when given, for `days` days, after which it stops; every cabinet that uses it still waits for an Admin's approval. `format` chooses what is returned: the launcher a person runs on the cabinet (default), or, for a site installer only, a PowerShell script a remote management tool runs as SYSTEM on each cabinet of the site.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action, site and limits included.

format.description: launcher: a .cmd run by a person next to the downloaded package. fleet-script: a PowerShell script for a remote management tool, run as SYSTEM, that downloads the package itself. A fleet script needs `site`.
